title.en: Jam Tracks Hub begins
title.zhTW: Jam Tracks Hub 正式起步

summary.en: The Homepage, About section, Tracks, Chord Progressions, and the first site foundation entered Git history.
summary.zhTW: 首頁、關於區塊、音軌、和弦進行與最初的網站基礎進入 Git 歷史。

details.en: About was part of the Homepage rather than a separate HTML page. Chord Progressions originally used chords.html and later changed route without becoming a new product.
details.zhTW: 「關於」是首頁的一部分，而不是獨立 HTML 頁面。和弦進行最初使用 chords.html，後來更換路由，但並非新產品。

title.en: The first backing-track library
title.zhTW: 第一批伴奏音軌資料庫

summary.en: W1–W8 established the recurring backing-track and slide collection.
summary.zhTW: W1–W8 建立了持續更新的伴奏音軌與投影片集合。

title.en: Key Finder becomes a dedicated tool
title.zhTW: 調性偵測器成為獨立工具

summary.en: Key Finder received its own public page for audio key analysis.
summary.zhTW: 調性偵測器獲得獨立公開頁面，用於音訊調性分析。

title.en: Privacy Policy introduced
title.zhTW: 推出隱私權政策

summary.en: The site added a dedicated public privacy policy.
summary.zhTW: 網站新增獨立的公開隱私權政策。

title.en: Service support routes added
title.zhTW: 新增服務支援路由

summary.en: Service-waking and 404 support pages were added without being presented as headline products.
summary.zhTW: 新增服務喚醒與 404 支援頁面，但不將其視為主要產品。

title.en: Shared styles become modular
title.zhTW: 共用樣式模組化

summary.en: Shared CSS was reorganized into a more maintainable site-wide foundation.
summary.zhTW: 共用 CSS 重整為更易維護的全站基礎。

title.en: Scale Explorer launches
title.zhTW: 音階探索器上線

summary.en: An interactive musical-scale reference joined the public toolset.
summary.zhTW: 互動式音階參考加入公開工具組。

title.en: Chord Dictionary launches
title.zhTW: 和弦字典上線

summary.en: A dedicated guitar chord-shape reference became available.
summary.zhTW: 吉他和弦指型的獨立參考工具正式提供。

title.en: Fretboard Trainer launches
title.zhTW: 指板訓練器上線

summary.en: A focused practice tool for learning fretboard notes joined the site.
summary.zhTW: 專注於學習指板音名的練習工具加入網站。

title.en: Homepage motion and track library evolve
title.zhTW: 首頁動態與音軌資料庫持續演進

summary.en: The Homepage entrance experience evolved while W10–W13 expanded the track collection.
summary.zhTW: 首頁進場體驗更新，同時 W10–W13 擴充音軌集合。

title.en: Progression Writer is published
title.zhTW: 和弦進行編寫器正式發布

summary.en: Progression Writer reached the canonical main branch after first being created in feature history on July 24.
summary.zhTW: 和弦進行編寫器於 7 月 24 日先在功能歷史中建立，並於 7 月 25 日進入正式 main 分支。

title.en: Responsive experience refined with W16
title.zhTW: 響應式體驗改善並新增 W16

summary.en: Light-interface and responsive refinements accompanied the W16 track addition.
summary.zhTW: 淺色介面與響應式改善，並加入 W16 音軌。

title.en: Traditional Chinese support arrives
title.zhTW: 推出繁體中文支援

summary.en: Jam Tracks Hub added a Traditional Chinese experience across public content.
summary.zhTW: Jam Tracks Hub 在公開內容中加入繁體中文體驗。

title.en: Feedback page opens
title.zhTW: 意見回饋頁面上線

summary.en: A public feedback page and supporting submission flow were introduced.
summary.zhTW: 推出公開意見回饋頁面與提交流程。

title.en: W19 joins the backing-track library
title.zhTW: W19 加入伴奏音軌資料庫

summary.en: The recurring track collection expanded with the confirmed W19 entry.
summary.zhTW: 持續更新的音軌集合加入已確認的 W19。

title.en: Song Workspace v1.0.0 is released
title.zhTW: 歌曲工作區 v1.0.0 正式發布

summary.en: The local-first guitar chart workspace reached its first canonical public release.
summary.zhTW: 以本機優先的吉他譜工作區迎來第一個正式公開版本。

details.en: The feature was created in Git on August 26 and first published through canonical main on August 28. My Songs is a view within Song Workspace, not a separate HTML page.
details.zhTW: 此功能於 8 月 26 日在 Git 中建立，並於 8 月 28 日首次透過正式 main 發布。「我的歌曲」是歌曲工作區內的檢視，而非獨立 HTML 頁面。

title.en: Legal page is published
title.zhTW: 法律資訊頁面正式發布

summary.en: The Legal page reached canonical main after being created in Git on August 27.
summary.zhTW: 法律資訊頁面於 8 月 27 日在 Git 中建立，並於 8 月 28 日進入正式 main。

title.en: Workspace responsiveness and Homepage behavior refined
title.zhTW: 改善工作區響應式與首頁行為

summary.en: Responsive workspace improvements shipped alongside Homepage regression fixes.
summary.zhTW: 推出工作區響應式改善與首頁回歸修正。

title.en: v1.1.0 streamlines adding on mobile
title.zhTW: v1.1.0 簡化行動版新增流程

summary.en: Global Add and mobile alignment made common Song Workspace actions more direct.
summary.zhTW: 全域新增與行動版對齊，讓歌曲工作區的常用操作更直接。

title.en: v1.2.0 revises the Workspace interface
title.zhTW: v1.2.0 改版工作區介面

summary.en: Workspace settings, editing controls, and responsive layouts received a focused revision.
summary.zhTW: 工作區設定、編輯控制與響應式版面獲得重點改版。

title.en: v1.3.0 improves My Songs and navigation
title.zhTW: v1.3.0 改善我的歌曲與導覽

summary.en: Saved-song management and smart navigation became more cohesive.
summary.zhTW: 已儲存歌曲管理與智慧導覽變得更一致。

title.en: Application protection is strengthened
title.zhTW: 強化應用程式保護

summary.en: Public-facing validation, privacy boundaries, and abuse resistance were strengthened at a high level.
summary.zhTW: 以高層次方式強化公開介面的驗證、隱私邊界與濫用防護。

details.en: This record intentionally omits defensive rules, thresholds, credentials, and internal detection details.
details.zhTW: 此紀錄刻意省略防禦規則、門檻、憑證與內部偵測細節。

title.en: Key Finder gains a protected public entry path
title.zhTW: 調性偵測器採用受保護的公開入口

summary.en: Public Key Finder requests began using edge protection while the existing compute service remained responsible for audio analysis.
summary.zhTW: 調性偵測器公開請求開始使用邊緣保護，既有運算服務仍負責音訊分析。

details.en: The public record describes responsibilities only and omits defensive configuration details.
details.zhTW: 公開紀錄僅說明職責分工，省略防禦設定細節。

title.en: v1.4.0 is recorded as a tag-only checkpoint
title.zhTW: v1.4.0 記錄為僅標籤檢查點

summary.en: The Git tag exists; no published GitHub Release was found.
summary.zhTW: Git 標籤存在，但找不到已發布的 GitHub Release。

title.en: v2.0.0 marks a security and infrastructure checkpoint
title.zhTW: v2.0.0 標誌安全與基礎設施檢查點

summary.en: A published release summarized application hardening and production protection without exposing defensive configuration.
summary.zhTW: 已發布版本概述應用程式強化與正式環境保護，且不揭露防禦設定。

title.en: Site-wide typography normalization ships
title.zhTW: 推出全站字體正規化

summary.en: A site-wide typography change was released and then reverted later the same day.
summary.zhTW: 全站字體變更發布後，於同日稍晚回復。

title.en: Typography change is rolled back
title.zhTW: 回復字體變更

summary.en: The tracked site styles were restored to their pre-normalization state.
summary.zhTW: 網站追蹤的樣式已恢復到字體正規化前的狀態。

title.en: Tracks and shared page details improve
title.zhTW: 改善音軌與共用頁面細節

summary.en: Responsive Tracks, footer, video, Legal, and Song Workspace entrance behavior received focused refinements.
summary.zhTW: 改善音軌、頁尾、影片、法律資訊與歌曲工作區進場行為的響應式細節。

title.en: v2.0.1 stabilizes Legal and Privacy pages
title.zhTW: v2.0.1 穩定法律與隱私權頁面

summary.en: Legal and Privacy typography and panels were stabilized across English and Traditional Chinese.
summary.zhTW: 穩定英文與繁體中文的法律與隱私權頁面字體及面板。

title.en: v2.0.2 adds privacy-bounded Song Workspace analytics
title.zhTW: v2.0.2 為歌曲工作區加入具隱私邊界的分析

summary.en: Song Workspace joined the site's pageview analytics while song content and the local-first storage model remained private to the browser.
summary.zhTW: 歌曲工作區納入網站頁面瀏覽分析，同時歌曲內容與本機優先儲存模式仍保留在瀏覽器中。

title.en: v2.0.3 restores reliable unknown-route handling
title.zhTW: v2.0.3 恢復可靠的未知路徑處理

summary.en: Unknown paths again reached the intended Vue 404 experience while retaining correct HTTP 404 semantics.
summary.zhTW: 未知路徑再次顯示預期的 Vue 404 體驗，同時維持正確的 HTTP 404 語意。

title.en: v2.0.4 restores the supported track download set
title.zhTW: v2.0.4 恢復支援的完整音軌下載集合

summary.en: Deployable W2–W8 ZIP packages restored download availability across all 18 supported track entries.
summary.zhTW: 可部署的 W2–W8 ZIP 套件恢復全部 18 個支援音軌項目的下載功能。

title.en: Key Finder frontend moves to Vue
title.zhTW: 調性偵測器前端遷移至 Vue

summary.en: Key Finder became Vue-owned while its existing protected API path and analysis responsibilities remained unchanged.
summary.zhTW: 調性偵測器改由 Vue 管理，同時既有受保護 API 路徑與分析職責維持不變。

title.en: Song Workspace completes its Vue migration
title.zhTW: 歌曲工作區完成 Vue 遷移

summary.en: The local-first workspace became Vue-owned while existing saved songs, browser storage, and import and export behavior remained compatible.
summary.zhTW: 本機優先的工作區改由 Vue 管理，同時維持既有已儲存歌曲、瀏覽器儲存與匯入匯出行為的相容性。

details.en: The migration preserved the established privacy boundary and did not introduce remote song storage.
details.zhTW: 此次遷移保留既有隱私邊界，且未引入遠端歌曲儲存。

title.en: v2.0.5 completes the Vue frontend migration
title.zhTW: v2.0.5 完成 Vue 前端遷移

summary.en: All 14 primary user-facing frontend pages became Vue-owned within the Vite multi-page architecture.
summary.zhTW: 14 個主要使用者前端頁面在 Vite 多頁式架構下全面改由 Vue 管理。

details.en: After migration verification, frontend code with no remaining runtime consumers was removed without changing public URLs or established product boundaries.
details.zhTW: 遷移驗證完成後，移除已無執行期使用者的前端程式碼，且未改變公開網址或既有產品邊界。

title.en: Homepage discovery adopts four purpose-led workflows
title.zhTW: 首頁探索改採四組目的導向流程

summary.en: PR #46 merged Practice, Understand, Create, and Play your songs groups into main, with Song Workspace entry points, localization improvements, and a compact About/contact/subscription layout.
summary.zhTW: PR #46 將「練習」、「理解」、「創作」與「彈奏自己的歌曲」分組合併至 main，並加入歌曲工作區入口、在地化改善，以及精簡的關於／聯絡／訂閱版面。

details.en: Song Workspace gained a Homepage hero action and a standard workflow tool-row link; its route, storage, and product behavior were unchanged. The workflow scroll pin and horizontal-travel behavior were removed. This record identifies a merge to main, not a verified production deployment.
details.zhTW: 歌曲工作區新增首頁主視覺操作與標準流程工具列連結；其路徑、儲存與產品行為維持不變。流程區的捲動固定與水平位移行為被移除。本紀錄確認的是合併至 main，而非已驗證的正式環境部署。

title.en: All Time analytics snapshots become more reliable
title.zhTW: 提升 All Time 分析快照的可靠性

summary.en: Daily Umami snapshots now explicitly select and verify All Time before capture. Screenshot validation accepts supported rendering variations while rejecting invalid images.
summary.zhTW: 每日 Umami 快照現在會在擷取前明確選取並確認 All Time。截圖驗證接受支援範圍內的渲染差異，同時拒絕無效影像。

details.en: PR #56 merged on September 16, 2026; the maintenance was included in v2.0.6, published on September 17 in Taipei time. If All Time cannot be confirmed, capture stops without publishing an incorrect snapshot. Existing dated snapshots were not rewritten.
details.zhTW: PR #56 於 2026 年 9 月 16 日合併；此維護納入台北時間 9 月 17 日發布的 v2.0.6。若無法確認 All Time，擷取便會停止，不發布錯誤快照。既有按日期保存的快照未被改寫。

title.en: Homepage About copy aligns across both languages
title.zhTW: 首頁關於文案完成雙語對齊

summary.en: PR #62 merged refreshed English and Traditional Chinese About headings and copy into main, with three paragraphs in each locale.
summary.zhTW: PR #62 將更新的英文與繁體中文關於標題及文案合併至 main，兩種語系皆採三段式內容。

details.en: The change was limited to copy, minimal About rendering, and tests. CSS, animations, routing, and other product pages were unchanged. This record does not assert production deployment or live-site validation.
details.zhTW: 變更限於文案、最小範圍的關於內容渲染與測試。CSS、動畫、路由及其他產品頁面均未更動。本紀錄不宣稱正式環境已部署或已完成線上網站驗證。

title.en: v3.0.0 begins the Liner Notes redesign
title.zhTW: v3.0.0 開啟 Liner Notes 改版

summary.en: A record-sleeve inspired design system replaced the previous look in the shared header, footer, typography and colors, and the homepage was rebuilt around it.
summary.zhTW: 以唱片封套為靈感的設計系統取代先前的外觀，套用於全站共用的頁首、頁尾、字體與配色，首頁也依此重新打造。

details.en: The light paper theme became the default, with a dark ink theme as the alternative. Headings use a serif display face with a Traditional Chinese serif fallback. The homepage moved to a flat, two-dimensional layout. Public URLs and product boundaries did not change.
details.zhTW: 淺色紙張主題成為預設，深色墨色主題作為替代選項。標題改用襯線展示字體，並搭配繁體中文襯線字體。首頁改為平面的二維版面。公開網址與產品邊界均未改變。

title.en: v3.1.0 turns Tracks into a record catalog
title.zhTW: v3.1.0 將音軌頁面改為唱片目錄

summary.en: The Tracks library became a compact catalog list. Each cover acts as a sleeve, and its record slides out on hover or keyboard focus.
summary.zhTW: 音軌資料庫改為精簡的目錄清單。每張封面化為唱片封套，滑鼠滑過或鍵盤聚焦時，黑膠會從封套中滑出。

details.en: On touch screens the record rests half out of its sleeve, and it stays still when reduced motion is requested. The decorative scrolling windmill was removed. Track data, filters and downloads did not change.
details.zhTW: 在觸控螢幕上，黑膠會半露於封套外；當裝置要求減少動態效果時則保持靜止。裝飾用的捲動風車已移除。音軌資料、篩選與下載功能均未改變。

title.en: v3.2.0 brings the tool pages into the redesign
title.zhTW: v3.2.0 將工具頁面納入改版

summary.en: Chord Dictionary, Scale Explorer, Chord Progressions, Progression Writer, Fretboard Trainer and Key Finder now share one heading style, flat panels and clear two-option toggles.
summary.zhTW: 和弦字典、音階探索器、和弦進行、和弦進行編寫器、指板訓練器與調性偵測器現在共用同一種標題樣式、平面面板與清楚的二選一切換按鈕。

details.en: Selections are filled in a soft cocoa tone, which also replaced the near-black accent band across the site, and buttons, fields and menus gained one gentle corner radius. Chord Progressions shape cards lift like a record on hover, Fretboard Trainer marks wrong answers with more than color, and the Tracks toolbar entrance now plays once. Tool behavior did not change.
details.zhTW: 選取狀態改以柔和的可可色填滿，全站接近黑色的強調色帶也一併改為可可色；按鈕、輸入欄位與選單統一採用柔和圓角。和弦進行的指型卡片在滑過時會像唱片般浮起，指板訓練器不再只靠顏色標示錯誤答案，音軌頁面工具列的進場動畫也只播放一次。各工具的功能均未改變。

title.en: v3.3.0 restyles Song Workspace as a liner-notes songbook
title.zhTW: v3.3.0 將歌曲工作區改為唱片內頁風格的歌本

summary.en: Song Workspace gained numbered create options, catalog-style song rows, numbered chart sections and a clearer line editor, while songs and lyrics still stay in the browser.
summary.zhTW: 歌曲工作區加入編號的建立選項、目錄式的歌曲列表、編號的段落與更清楚的單行編輯器，歌曲與歌詞仍然只保存在瀏覽器中。

details.en: Performance Mode follows the paper or ink theme, and phones get a single-column layout with a swipeable chord-shape strip. Chord Progressions mini shapes now use the same chord-tone colors as Chord Dictionary, while Scale Explorer keeps its scale-degree colors. The change was limited to presentation.
details.zhTW: 演出模式會跟隨紙張或墨色主題；手機版改為單欄版面，並可左右滑動和弦指型。和弦進行的小型指型改用與和弦字典相同的和弦音配色，音階探索器則保留音級配色。此次變更僅限於呈現方式。

title.en: v3.4.0 completes the Liner Notes redesign
title.zhTW: v3.4.0 完成 Liner Notes 改版

summary.en: Feedback, Legal, Privacy, the not-found page and the Key Finder wake-up screen moved to the Liner Notes style, completing the redesign across the site.
summary.zhTW: 意見回饋、法律資訊、隱私權政策、找不到頁面與調性偵測器喚醒畫面改為 Liner Notes 風格，全站改版至此完成。

details.en: Legal and Privacy number their sections beside an On this page list that collapses on phones, and every Privacy section gained its own link. The not-found page shows a record sleeve, and the wake-up screen spins a record that stops when the check ends or when reduced motion is requested. Policy text, feedback sending and the wake-up checks did not change.
details.zhTW: 法律資訊與隱私權政策的段落加上編號，旁邊附有「本頁內容」目錄，在手機上可收合；隱私權政策的每個段落也都有了專屬連結。找不到頁面顯示一張唱片封套，喚醒畫面則以轉動的黑膠呈現，檢查結束或裝置要求減少動態效果時會停止轉動。政策內容、意見回饋的送出方式與喚醒檢查均未改變。

title.en: v3.5.0 writes the homepage title by hand
title.zhTW: v3.5.0 以手寫方式寫出首頁標題

summary.en: The homepage heading now reads Jam Tracks Hub and is written stroke by stroke in the Yellowtail script, followed by a waveform, a double rule and the tagline.
summary.zhTW: 首頁標題改為「Jam Tracks Hub」，以 Yellowtail 手寫體依筆順逐筆寫出，接著出現波形、雙線與標語。

details.en: Each letter appears only where the pen has written, following the glyph's own centre line, and the title writes once when the page opens. When reduced motion is requested or the font cannot load, the whole title appears at once, and screen readers still read a single heading. The rest of the homepage did not change.
details.zhTW: 每個字母只在筆畫寫過的地方出現，並沿著字形中心線書寫；標題在頁面開啟時只寫一次。裝置要求減少動態效果或字型無法載入時，會直接顯示完整標題，螢幕閱讀器仍只讀到一個標題。首頁其餘內容均未改變。

title.en: v3.5.1 fixes the phone tagline and tablet chord shapes
title.zhTW: v3.5.1 修正手機標語與平板指型

summary.en: The homepage tagline no longer breaks mid-sentence on phones, and Chord Progressions no longer clips chord names or shapes on tablets.
summary.zhTW: 首頁標語在手機上不再於句子中間斷行，和弦進行在平板上也不再截斷和弦名稱或指型。

details.en: The tagline splits after its first sentence onto a left and a right line, but only when it does not fit on one line. Chord Progressions now stacks the chords above their shapes at every size, with four shapes per row on wide screens, two on tablets and one on phones; the mini diagrams line up their strings with the string names, and longer progressions such as the 12-bar blues place each group of bars directly above its own shapes.
details.zhTW: 標語只在一行放不下時，才於第一句後分成靠左與靠右的兩行。和弦進行在各種寬度都改為和弦在上、指型在下，寬螢幕每列四張、平板兩張、手機一張；小型指型圖的琴弦與弦名對齊，12 小節藍調等較長的進行則讓每組小節緊接在自己的指型上方。

title.en: v3.5.2 aligns the inner pages
title.zhTW: v3.5.2 統一內頁版面

summary.en: After a site-wide consistency check, the inner pages share one column width, title size and spacing, with compact centred headings on phones.
summary.zhTW: 經過全站一致性檢查，內頁統一欄寬、標題大小與間距，手機上改為精簡置中的開頭。

details.en: Backing Tracks, the tool pages, Song Workspace, Feedback, Legal and Privacy now share a 1200px column and the same title size, and Song Workspace's heading starts as high as the tools'. On phones the heading block is compact and centred while everything below it stays left-aligned, longer intros keep balanced line lengths, and the Privacy title breaks right after the brand. The homepage, the not-found page and the wake-up screen kept their own layouts.
details.zhTW: 即興伴奏、各工具頁、歌曲工作區、意見回饋、法律資訊與隱私權政策統一為 1200px 欄寬與相同的標題大小，歌曲工作區的標題也與工具頁對齊高度。手機上開頭改為精簡置中，下方內容維持靠左，較長的導言保持均衡的行長，隱私權政策標題則在品牌名稱後斷行。首頁、找不到頁面與喚醒畫面維持各自的版面。

title.en: v3.5.3 tidies wording and search details
title.zhTW: v3.5.3 整理文字與搜尋設定

summary.en: Inner pages now follow one set of rules for taglines, section headings, buttons and links, and search engines get clean page addresses and a sitemap.
summary.zhTW: 內頁的標語、段落標題、按鈕與連結改用同一套規則，搜尋引擎也取得乾淨的頁面網址與網站地圖。

details.en: Every inner page tagline became the accent red, section headings share one size, and buttons share one height and weight. Backing Tracks, Chord Progressions and Progression Writer got their own taglines instead of reusing the homepage line, the privacy page dropped its brand prefix, and back links read "Back to Home" without an arrow. Each page now declares its clean address, a sitemap lists the 12 public pages, and Song Workspace gained the sharing preview the other pages already had.
details.zhTW: 所有內頁標語改為強調紅色，段落標題統一大小，按鈕也統一高度與字重。即興伴奏、和弦進行與和弦進行編寫器有了各自的標語，不再沿用首頁標語；隱私權頁面拿掉品牌前綴，返回連結改為不帶箭頭的「回到首頁」。每個頁面都宣告乾淨的網址，網站地圖列出 12 個公開頁面，歌曲工作區也補上其他頁面已有的分享預覽。

title.en: v4.0.0 moves the site to the Jazz Stage design
title.zhTW: v4.0.0 全站改為 Jazz Stage 設計

summary.en: Every page moved from the Liner Notes paper look to a jazz record stage with navy and cream, a yellow rule, rounded trays and condensed capital titles, in a day theme and a night theme.
summary.zhTW: 所有頁面從 Liner Notes 的紙張風格改為爵士唱片舞台：深藍與米白、黃色線條、圓角托盤與窄體大寫標題，並分為白天與夜晚兩種主題。

details.en: The day theme, still the default, pairs warm paper with navy text and teal accents; the night theme uses deep navy with cream text and yellow accents. Each theme shows its own homepage line: "House lights up. Let's rehearse." by day and "Lights down. You're on." at night. The homepage title became JAM TRACKS HUB in Anton capitals beside the red record sleeve on a navy stage, and the record slides out on hover like the Backing Tracks records; the handwritten title from v3.5.0 was retired. Page titles use Anton, section headings keep DM Serif Display and body text uses Work Sans. Buttons and fields now use the site font everywhere, and the Scale Explorer download became a v4-style image with a light or dark background. Saved theme and language settings carried over, and no tools or content were removed.
details.zhTW: 白天主題仍是預設，以溫暖紙色搭配深藍文字與青綠強調色；夜晚主題採用深藍底、米白文字與黃色強調色。兩種主題在首頁各有一句標語：白天是「燈光亮起，來排練吧。」，夜晚是「燈光暗下，換你上場。」。首頁標題改為 Anton 大寫的 JAM TRACKS HUB，旁邊是放在深藍舞台上的紅色唱片封套，滑鼠移上時唱片會像即興伴奏頁的唱片一樣滑出；v3.5.0 的手寫標題因此退役。頁面標題使用 Anton，段落標題維持 DM Serif Display，內文使用 Work Sans。按鈕與輸入欄位全面改用網站字體，音階探索器的下載圖也改為 v4 風格，並可選擇淺色或深色背景。已儲存的主題與語言設定沿用，沒有移除任何工具或內容。

title.en: v4.0.1 polishes the Scale Explorer image
title.zhTW: v4.0.1 細修音階探索器圖片

summary.en: The downloaded scale image now follows the page language, and its light or dark background switch turns yellow on hover.
summary.zhTW: 下載的音階圖片改為跟隨頁面語言，淺色／深色背景切換在滑鼠移上時改為黃色。

details.en: In Traditional Chinese the image now reads 吉他音階圖, 標準調弦, 弦 and 保留所有權利 instead of English, and it waits for the fonts those labels need. The unselected background option no longer fades into the navy panel in the day theme. Homepage styles left over from v3 that no longer applied were removed without changing how the homepage looks.
details.zhTW: 繁體中文介面下載的圖片改為顯示「吉他音階圖」、「標準調弦」、「弦」與「保留所有權利」等中文文字，並會等待這些文字所需的字型載入。白天主題中未選取的背景選項不再融入深藍面板。另外移除了 v3 遺留、已不再套用的首頁樣式，首頁外觀不變。

title.en: v4.0.2 fixes the tablet homepage and adds a title entrance
title.zhTW: v4.0.2 修正平板首頁並加入標題進場

summary.en: The homepage opening is now left-aligned on tablets like on phones and desktops, and JAM, TRACKS, HUB and the volume line rise into place one after another when the page opens.
summary.zhTW: 平板上的首頁開場改為與手機、桌機一致的靠左對齊；頁面開啟時，JAM、TRACKS、HUB 與期數文字會依序升起。

details.en: Before, the volume line, tagline and intro were centred under a left-aligned title on tablets. On tablets held upright the title now sits beside the record instead of above it, and the writing on the record sleeve resizes with the sleeve so its line is no longer cut off. The entrance takes about a second, plays once without a flash, and is skipped when the device asks for reduced motion. Desktop and phone layouts did not change.
details.zhTW: 先前平板上的期數、標語與介紹文字置中，卻排在靠左的標題下方。直立平板上的標題現在放在唱片旁邊而不是上方，唱片封套上的文字也會跟著封套縮放，不再被裁切。進場動畫約一秒、只播放一次且不會先閃現；裝置要求減少動態效果時則直接顯示。桌機與手機版面不變。

title.en: v4.0.3 brings downloads and chord diagrams into v4
title.zhTW: v4.0.3 讓下載與和弦圖跟上 v4

summary.en: Progression Writer images, Song Workspace printouts, track slide pages and link previews now use the v4 look, and chord diagrams get clearer interval colors and cleaner dots.
summary.zhTW: 和弦進行編寫器圖片、歌曲工作區列印、音軌投影片頁與連結預覽都改用 v4 風格，和弦圖也換上更清楚的音程配色與更乾淨的圓點。

details.en: Progression Writer images became a navy stage with the song name and rounded chord cards in day or night colors, with labels in the page language. Song Workspace Print / PDF had been printing a blank page; charts now print in navy on white without the editing buttons. Link previews on LINE, Facebook and other apps show the v4 homepage, because the share image had been missing. Chord diagrams use deep dots with light labels by day and light dots with navy labels at night, dots on neighbouring strings no longer touch, and the guitar shape picker uses the site's rounded cards. On tablets, Latest Releases sits on the left and the homepage buttons are no longer cut off as they appear.
details.zhTW: 和弦進行編寫器的圖片改為深藍舞台，放上歌曲名稱與圓角和弦卡，並依主題使用白天或夜晚配色，文字跟隨頁面語言。歌曲工作區的列印／PDF 先前會印出空白頁，現在以白底深藍印出譜面，且不含編輯按鈕。LINE、Facebook 等應用程式的連結預覽改為顯示 v4 首頁，因為先前網站缺少分享圖片。和弦圖白天使用深色圓點配淺色文字、夜晚使用淺色圓點配深藍文字，相鄰弦的圓點不再相連，吉他指型選擇器也改用網站的圓角卡片。平板上的「最新發佈」改為靠左，首頁按鈕在出現時也不再被裁切。

title.en: v4.0.4 corrects the labels on extended chords
title.zhTW: v4.0.4 修正延伸和弦的音程標示

summary.en: On every 9th, 11th and 13th chord, each diagram dot had shown the wrong interval; Chord Dictionary, Progression Writer, Song Workspace and downloaded images now label every tone correctly.
summary.zhTW: 所有 9、11、13 和弦的和弦圖圓點先前都標錯音程；和弦字典、和弦進行編寫器、歌曲工作區與下載圖片現在都會正確標示每個音。

details.en: On A9, for example, the C# had been marked 5 and the B marked 3. The fix covers 9, maj9, m9, 11, m11, 13, maj13 and m13 chords. Chord Dictionary notes now line up with the formula above them and are spelled correctly, so Ab13's b7 reads Gb rather than F#. Shapes, fingerings and sounds were unchanged; only labels and note names had been wrong. On desktop, Open Song Workspace became the same width as Browse Backing Tracks above it.
details.zhTW: 例如在 A9 上，C# 原本被標成 5、B 被標成 3。這次修正涵蓋 9、maj9、m9、11、m11、13、maj13 與 m13 和弦。和弦字典的音名也與上方公式對齊並改用正確拼法，例如 Ab13 的 b7 寫作 Gb 而不是 F#。指型、指法與聲音都沒有變，錯的只有標示與音名。桌機上的「開啟歌曲工作區」按鈕也改為與上方的「瀏覽即興伴奏」同寬。

title.en: v4.0.5 tidies form fields
title.zhTW: v4.0.5 整理表單欄位

summary.en: After an iPhone report, Progression Writer, Song Workspace and homepage fields were made to share one rounded style with their labels always above.
summary.zhTW: 在收到 iPhone 使用回報後，和弦進行編寫器、歌曲工作區與首頁的欄位改用同一種圓角樣式，標籤固定顯示在上方。

details.en: In Progression Writer, Song Name, Key and BPM now match the chord fields: an empty field no longer hides its label, the label no longer overlaps typed text on iPhone, BPM lost the browser's arrows, and Song Name gets its own row on tablets. Song Workspace menus use the site's rounded fields in Safari instead of Safari's own small menus. On phones, the homepage email field and Subscribe button are stacked so the whole address fits. No tools or content changed.
details.zhTW: 在和弦進行編寫器中，歌曲名稱、調性與 BPM 欄位改為與和弦欄位一致：空白欄位不再把標籤藏在裡面，iPhone 上的標籤也不再壓住輸入的文字，BPM 拿掉瀏覽器的上下箭頭，平板上的歌曲名稱也有了自己的一列。歌曲工作區的選單在 Safari 中改用網站的圓角欄位，不再顯示 Safari 自帶的小選單。手機上的首頁電子郵件欄位與訂閱按鈕改為上下排列，完整地址放得下。沒有變更任何工具或內容。

title.en: v4.1.0 opens Chord Lab
title.zhTW: v4.1.0 推出和弦實驗室

summary.en: Chord Lab is a new page for chords beyond the Chord Dictionary: type any chord symbol, such as Gmaj7add13 or D/F#, and get the five best guitar shapes across the neck.
summary.zhTW: 和弦實驗室是處理和弦字典以外和弦的新頁面：輸入任何和弦符號，例如 Gmaj7add13 或 D/F#，就能得到指板上最好按的五個吉他指型。

details.en: Chord Lab reads sevenths, add, sus, 9, 11 and 13, #11, b9 and b13, slash chords, omit, alt, 6 and 6/9, with one or two examples of each next to the field. It shows the chord's tones in the site's chord-tone colors and marks the ones you can leave out. Shapes are ranked by stretch, number of fingers and completeness, and can be re-ranked near a fret or filtered by root. Rootless shapes common in funk and jazz are included and marked, since every other shape on the site includes the root. Any shape can be played, the top five download as an image, and a button suggests three levels of simpler chords with each change spelled out. Chord Lab joined the header and the Tools menu, which on mid-size desktop screens also holds Key Finder, Song Workspace and Fretboard Trainer.
details.zhTW: 和弦實驗室支援七和弦、add、sus、9／11／13、#11、b9、b13、分割和弦、omit、alt、6 與 6/9，並在輸入框旁為每種寫法附上一到兩個範例。頁面以網站的和弦音配色列出和弦組成音，並標出可省略的音。指型依伸展幅度、手指數與完整度排序，可改為以某個琴格附近排序，也可依根音篩選。頁面也收錄 Funk 與爵士常用的無根音指型並清楚標示，因為網站其他指型都含根音。每個指型都能播放，前五個可下載成圖片，另有按鈕提供三個層級的簡化和弦，並寫出每個變動。和弦實驗室加入頁首與工具選單；在中等寬度的桌機螢幕上，工具選單也收納調性偵測器、歌曲工作區與指板訓練器。

title.en: v4.1.1 quiets the Key Finder console
title.zhTW: v4.1.1 讓調性偵測器的主控台不再報錯

summary.en: Key Finder no longer checks for the optional local YouTube helper while the page loads, which had logged a console error on every visit.
summary.zhTW: 調性偵測器不再於頁面載入時檢查選用的本機 YouTube 輔助程式，先前這項檢查在每次造訪都會留下主控台錯誤。

details.en: The site's security policy blocks those checks, so they never succeeded on the public site. The YouTube status now shows the site analyzer straight away, which is what visitors already saw once the check failed. The helper is still tried when you ask for it, and the security policy stayed unchanged. No tools, content or layouts changed.
details.zhTW: 網站的安全政策會擋下這些檢查，所以它們在公開網站上從未成功。YouTube 狀態現在直接顯示網站分析器，這也是檢查失敗後訪客原本就會看到的內容。使用者主動要求時仍會嘗試使用輔助程式，安全政策也維持不變。沒有變更任何工具、內容或版面。
